brief.headline: Close the ₹82,500 annual gap on measuring cups and push payment to 30 days to free ₹10.19 L cash for us

priceAsk.summary: Match Premier Plastic's ₹0.35/NOS price on the measuring cup SKU
priceAsk.basis: We pay Mars ₹0.38/NOS but Premier Plastic supplies the same item at ₹0.35/NOS — an 8.6% gap. The market ask for similar 28 mm PP caps runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, so ₹0.35 is well below market and Mars can match it.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹10.19 L cash freed up for us

brief.financialLeverage: Mars Plastics publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. Our ₹1.24 Cr annual spend might be meaningful to a private converter, but without their numbers we don't know. That means we lean on our own data — the ₹82,500 gap to Premier Plastic — and on having strong alternates lined up. We keep the tone firm but fair: we need a second source anyway, and Mars earns the business by matching the best price we already pay elsewhere.

evidence.point: We overpay Mars ₹82,500 a year on one SKU alone
Premier Plastic's price on the same measuring cup is ₹0.35/NOS; Mars charges ₹0.38/NOS
Pulling payment in by 15 days frees over ₹10 lakh of our cash
Market asking price for a similar 28 mm PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, so ₹0.35 is well within reach
Mars is private and shares no financial data

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, makes pharma bottles and caps, health score B (65/100) — the strongest second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed, ₹1010.97 Cr revenue, strong health B (73/100), pharma-proven rigid-plastic specialist

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (lead to qualify)
alternates.why: A maker lead from public research (verify capability and pricing before RFQ)

risks: Mars shares no financials — we can't judge whether a hard push on price and payment might strain them, so watch their reaction and be ready to stage the asks
We spend only ₹1.24 Cr annually with them; if they're a large converter we may have less pull than we think
Moving all volume to Premier Plastic or another alternate without qualifying Mars's capacity might leave us short if demand spikes
The market-ask data is for 28 mm caps, not an exact SKU match — confirm our measuring cup spec truly aligns before citing it in the room
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to keep Mars as a partner, but right now we're paying you ₹0.38 when Premier Plastic delivers the same item at ₹0.35 — let's close that gap and talk about tighter payment terms so this works for both of us.
